content:
deploybot: Release rollout started for release/rc-2026.08.12 -> canary us-west-2. Gate check failed: sentinel-alert 'db-read-retry-rate' triggered. Automatic hold applied. Holding rollout. Details: https://deploys.internal/redwood/rc-2026.08.12

elaine: Copy, thanks. @jia can you take oncall?

jia: Oncall here — seeing elevated DB read retries in us-west-2 from 22:14–22:18 UTC. Investigating replication lag and slow reads.

omar: If it's read retries, could be a query pattern regression. Can we pin to previous image as a mitigation?

tess: prod: Any visible user impact reported?

jia: Small spike in 502s for webhook delivery (~0.1% of requests). Not global but risk of escalation. I'm going to roll back the canary to the last known-good image: release/2026.08.11-hotfix.

mike: platform: Agreed on rollback. Also recommend moving full rollout to off-peak window and extend canary duration.

jia: Initiating rollback. Command:
```
deploybot rollback --env=canary --image=2026.08.11-hotfix --reason="db-read-retry spikes"
```

deploybot: Rollback initiated by jia at 3776543410. Canary reverted to release/2026.08.11-hotfix. Monitoring for stability.

omar: Monitoring db metrics now. Will validate latency and KV cache warmup; will post updates in 10m.

elaine: Proposed next steps: mark rollout paused, pin the canary image as fallback, update the change window to 02:00–05:00 UTC tomorrow, and tighten canary batch to 5%.

mike: Done — deploy window updated to 02:00–05:00 UTC (tomorrow). Circuit breaker thresholds tightened; canary batch size set to 5% for the resumed rollout.

tess: I'll draft a short status page update and release note addendum mentioning the pause, rollback, and new window. Will post 30m before the window.

jia: Also pinning model/service version on Dedicated nodes to avoid auto-updates: `pin_version: 2026.08.11-hotfix`

omar: ACK — will run extra validation checks after canary warms. If metrics look good, we can proceed with staged rollout.

elaine: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases 01:15 UTC for a final go/no-go thread.
